# Acquired, capped Gaussian-mean channels at square-root dimension cost

27 October 2026. This is a constructive general comparator, not a solution
of N687's polylogarithmic dimension target and not a novelty claim. The
positive likelihood mechanism is the Gaussian cloud fluctuation correction
of Chen--Chewi--Lu--Zhang, arXiv:2609.38710v1, Theorem 4.2. Below its relevant
Gaussian specialization is reconstructed with explicit conservative constants,
an everywhere-defined value-only action, actual Brownian-path acquisition,
and a deterministic cap. No source-dependent fitting is performed.

## Theorem and fully specified costs

Let `g=grad F:R^d->R^d` be globally `L`-Lipschitz, `F in C^{1,1}`,
`sigma>0`, and `0<epsilon<=1/4`. Exact whole-vector values of `g`, standard
Gaussian seeds and real arithmetic are available. There is a positive
randomized algorithm whose ideal-real output is within TV `epsilon` of
`N(Eg(G),sigma^2 I)` and whose EVERY-execution source-query count is at most

    1 + A [M + 8 J K].                                  (1)

Put `rho=L/sigma`; the `L=0` case is one query followed by Gaussian noise.
For `L>0`, use the following explicit parameter choices. Ceilings can be
implemented by bounded scalar loops; the logarithms only specify integers.

    p = 2 ceil(log(128/epsilon)/log 16),
    R_p = sqrt(d p)+p,
    M = ceil(256(1+rho^2) R_p),
    alpha = 2rho^2/M,
    K = max(1,ceil(log(64d/epsilon)/log(1/alpha))),
    B = 1/4,
    A = ceil(log_2(64/epsilon)),
    J = ceil(log_2(64A/epsilon)),
    s = epsilon/[32 max(1,rho) sqrt(d)],
    r = s epsilon/[192 max(1,alpha d)].                   (2)

One additional query at zero removes an arbitrary constant offset. It is
optional in exact real arithmetic, but included in (1). All other queries,
including rejected proposals, are included. The leading dimension cost is
`sqrt(d)` up to logarithms, while accuracy costs are logarithmic. The large
displayed constants are for a transparent proof, not practical optimization.

COMPLETED CURATOR MATHEMATICAL REVIEW | 28 October 2026

Decision: accept the listed mathematical/program interfaces at their
explicit contracts. This is a new source-read reconstruction,not transfer of
Q52 first-return acceptance. It is not fresh/blind: the curator retains full
programme/earlier science context and knows A's identity. No producer feedback,
archived scientific execution,external priority search or experiment occurred.
Original supplied diagnostics remain source-reported. Acceptance is of the
specified ideal-real finite algorithms/analysis,not measured executable speed,
finite-bit law,novelty or the general N687 target.

1. Full-joint record absorption. With LL^T=C,TT^T=C_new and
D=[-T^-1 L;H A L],the proposed precision condition gives
D^T D=L^T(C_new^-1+A^T H^T H A)L=I-L^T J L.
Thus P P^T=I-DD^T is a known valid Gaussian covariance. The exact child gauge
turns its noisy center into effective seeds PG-DZ;their complete covariance is
I. They are jointly Gaussian,so all effective slots,retained record and
standalone children have the claimed independence. This is more than covariance
matching of non-Gaussian outputs. TV contracts under the actual Markov kernel,
then independent standalone errors add. All metadata must be fixed independently
of the observed noisy record;data-dependent coefficients invalidate the proof.

Final DAG precision is D_noise^-1-A^T Gamma A. Its positive definiteness implies
the intermediate condition by principal restriction plus unread PSD costs.
The W2 coordinate recurrence pays each downstream center Lipschitz coefficient;
it does not assume independent actual errors. Query caps survive correlated
seeds only because they hold on EVERY execution. Final affine variance must
remain below the target before any fresh reserve is added.

For response closure r=C P1 u and q=[T^-1(u-r);H A r] satisfy D^Tq=0.
The direct energy is u^T(P1-P1 C P1)u;combined with the existing response bound
it yields rho^-1 P1. Child reserve orthogonality kills cross terms. The external
gauge construction has fresh energy s-t and old-response energy<=t/rho,
so its increment is<=sqrt(s/rho). It cannot be declared orthogonal to every
constructed reserve. The unused-slot augmentation preserves actual output and
queries while paying factor2 reserve loss and sqrt(2) gauge growth per promotion.
Neither isolated factor establishes total polylog closure.
